Enterprise SIP RFC 3326 Reason Q.850 Anti-Spoofing & RFC 8599 Push-Wake Guard
Eliminating Spoofed Q.850 / SIP;cause=200 Headers, pn-provider SSRF & Mobile Sleep Premature 480 Call Drops
🎉 95TH SVG & 905 GUARDRAILS
454 Dims · 914 Probes · 893 Tests
❌ Unguarded RFC 3326/8599: Q.850 Spoofing & Mobile 480 Drop
1. RFC 3326 Reason Header (Q.850 / SIP;cause=200) Spoofing
• Untrusted carrier injects Reason: Q.850;cause=1 (Unallocated Number)
to hide trunk congestion → AI dialer permanently deletes valid leads!
• Rogue caller sends CANCEL with Reason: SIP;cause=200 ("Call completed
elsewhere") → completely erases missed-call alert on executive phone!
Result: Corrupted Outbound Retry Engines & Suppressed Missed-Call Logs
2. RFC 8599 Mobile Sleep Instant 480 Drop & pn-provider SSRF
• iOS/Android suspends background TCP socket after 10s to save battery.
• Without RFC 8599 INVITE parking, proxy returns 480 in 0ms (32% drops).
• Unvalidated Contact pn-provider URL allows attacker to trigger
Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) against internal cloud metadata!
Result: 32% Mobile Callback Failure Rate & Internal SSRF Exposure
✅ RFC 3326 Strip Guard (P895) & RFC 8599 Push-Wake Guard (P896 🎉)
P895 · RFC 3326 Untrusted Reason Strip & Q.850 [1, 127] Bounds Guard
• Strips 100% of inbound Reason headers on untrusted external trunks.
• Blocks spoofed SIP;cause=200 missed-call suppression & fake cause=1.
• Locally maps authentic disconnect causes & clamps Q.850 to [1, 127].
• 100% protects CDR accuracy & outbound dialer retry state machines!
clampedSpoofedReasonOrInvalidQ850Headers = 0 · Q.850 Cause ∈ [1, 127]
P896 (🎉 905th Guard!) · RFC 8599 Allowlist & [4000, 12000]ms Hold Guard
• Enforces strict APNs/FCM allowlist on pn-provider (SIP 555 on failure).
• Parks incoming INVITE in tsilo queue for [4,000, 12,000]ms (6,000ms).
• Dispatches async push wake-up & bridges INVITE in 0ms upon matching
+sip.instance re-REGISTER (>99.4% mobile wake completion rate)!
clampedUnallowlistedPushOrPremature480Calls = 0 · Hold ∈ [4000, 12000]ms
